title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Logging Analytics

fields.name: config_file_location
fields.description: The location of the configuration file that contains OCI authentication details.

fields.name: namespace
fields.description: The OCI tenancy namespace to upload log data to.

fields.name: oci_config_in_record
fields.description: If set to true, the following oci_la_* parameters will be read from the record itself instead of the output plugin configuration.

fields.name: oci_la_entity_id
fields.description: The OCID of the Log Analytics entity.

fields.name: oci_la_entity_type
fields.description: The entity type of the Log Analytics entity.

fields.name: oci_la_global_metadata
fields.description: Specifies additional global metadata along with original log content to Log Analytics. The format is key_name value. This option can be set multiple times.

fields.name: oci_la_log_group_id
fields.description: Required. The Oracle Cloud Identifier (OCID) of the Log Analytics log group where you want to store logs.

fields.name: oci_la_log_path
fields.description: Specifies the original location of the log files.

fields.name: oci_la_log_set_id
fields.description: The OCID of the Log Analytics log set.

fields.name: oci_la_log_source_name
fields.description: Required. The Log Analytics Source to use for processing log records.

fields.name: oci_la_metadata
fields.description: Specifies additional metadata for a log event along with original log content to Log Analytics. The format is key_name value. This option can be set multiple times.

fields.name: profile_name
fields.description: The OCI configuration profile name to be used from the configuration file.

fields.name: proxy
fields.description: The proxy name, in http://host:port format. Only supports HTTP protocol.

fields.name: uri
fields.description: The URI for the OCI Log Analytics REST API request.

fields.name: workers
fields.description: The number of workers to perform flush operations for this output.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.

description: Fluent Bit output plugin: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Logging Analytics.
